newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends down, rates seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends down, rates seen falling.

text.p: The Philippine peso continued to weaken on Friday to close at 26.211 from 26.201 after the Central Bank took steps to influence interest rates down further, traders said.
The Central Bank limited its overnight borrowing early Friday and kept its termed reverse repos out of the market for the second straight day, traders said.
The day's average was at 26.211 from 26.202 on Thursday.
